faqs.question: What is your refund policy?
faqs.answer: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and bank transfer.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings > Billing and click Cancel subscription. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your email. We'll send a reset link that is valid for 1 hour.

faqs.question: How do I change my email address?
faqs.answer: Open Settings > Profile, edit the email field and confirm via the verification link sent to the new address.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7-14 business days and customs fees may apply.

faqs.question: What is Footnote?
faqs.answer: Footnote is a help chatbot for your website. It answers visitors from your own FAQs and articles, and every answer names the article it came from.

faqs.question: Does Footnote use AI or an LLM?
faqs.answer: No. Footnote matches questions with PostgreSQL full-text search, synonyms and intents. There is no LLM, no embeddings and no per-message AI bill, so it only ever says what your content says.

faqs.question: How do I add Footnote to my website?
faqs.answer: Paste one script tag before </body> on your site. The dashboard's Install tab gives you the exact line for your chatbot, and lets you list the websites allowed to show it.

faqs.question: What content can Footnote answer from?
faqs.answer: FAQs you write, and documents you upload: PDF, Word, Markdown, plain text or a CSV of FAQs. You can also import a web page. Footnote never answers from anything else.

faqs.question: What happens when Footnote can't answer?
faqs.answer: It says so instead of guessing. When a match is weak it offers “Did you mean” suggestions, and it can hand the visitor to your team by email, WhatsApp, a contact form, a ticket or a live chat.

faqs.question: Can I customize how the widget looks?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Customize tab sets the theme, colors, corner, button icon, greeting, starter questions and the intro animation, with a live preview before you save.

faqs.question: How do I see what visitors ask?
faqs.answer: Analytics lists the questions visitors asked, how each was answered, and the ones Footnote couldn't answer. Turn any of those into an FAQ in one click.

faqs.question: Can my team share one dashboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your organization is your workspace: invite teammates and everyone works on the same chatbots, FAQs and inbox.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect your name, email address, billing address and order history to provide our service. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Account data is retained while your account is active. After account deletion, personal data is erased within 90 days, except where law requires us to keep invoices.
